result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are a few visible polish issues: a likely misspelled search placeholder, horizontal content clipped at the right edge without clear affordance, and some low-contrast secondary text/icons.

issues.description: Search placeholder appears to read “Restarants” instead of “Restaurants”.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder spelling to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.

issues.description: The category chip row and “Fastest near you” cards are cut off at the right edge, with the next chip/card only partially visible and no scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade, scrollbar/indicator, or adjust padding so horizontally scrollable content is clearly discoverable and not awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: Placeholder/search text and some secondary gray labels look low contrast against light gray backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast to meet WCAG AA, especially for placeholder and metadata text.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons on dark food imagery may be hard to distinguish depending on image brightness.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent filled/contrasting icon treatment or add a subtle backdrop to keep the action visible over any image.
